source_roster: Exact prior source-test roster from each public training partition, now used to fit the new covariance and deterministic controls.
evaluation_roster: All already-open DLO4 and DLO5 official evaluation trajectories; no selection or replacement.
reference_alignment: Float32 (500,3,12), transpose, z clipping, then [2:] to match the sealed (498,12,3) predictions.
observations: Only complementary current-time internal node coordinates. No active selection. Each update starts from the same frozen prior; no recursive simulator feedback.

covariance_fit.method: Residual second moment about the unchanged prior, correlation-space rank truncation, diagonal residual retained
covariance_fit.observation_variance_status: Assumed likelihood regularizer, not measured sensor calibration

controls.diagonal: Same means and coordinate variances; no cross-node or cross-time covariance
controls.scrambled: S P S with fixed Rademacher sign seeds 601,602,603,604; preserve eigenvalues and coordinate variances; average losses, not predictions
controls.global: Global visible residual, with source-fitted scalar gain per mask and horizon in [0,2]
controls.interpolation: Material-index linear interpolation of visible residuals, with source-fitted scalar gain per mask and horizon in [0,2]
controls.unchanged: Original sealed candidate; diagonal must reproduce its hidden coordinates exactly

primary.metric: Mean complete-trajectory hidden-node Euclidean 3D RMSE in mm
primary.positive_rule: Full covariance beats all three controls with upper paired 98.333% bootstrap endpoints below zero; Bonferroni familywise alpha 0.05

secondary: Report all three masks and four horizons, global control, per-DLO effects, wins, coverage, width, normalized NEES and joint Gaussian NLL per coordinate regardless of signs.

bootstrap.unit: Complete trajectory, stratified within DLO4 and DLO5; equal DLO means

claim_boundary: Retrospective empirical joint predictive-error conditioning, not an exact latent-physics posterior, simulator-state feedback, fresh confirmation, camera-occlusion robustness, population-level object generalization, or calibration. Source residuals use the earlier 39-fit hybrid; evaluation means use unchanged all-56 retraining. Deterministic MAP under the identical joint Gaussian model equals the conditional mean.
